`stb_dxt.h` v1.13 is vendored unchanged from nothings/stb, commit
`9600522de53973336fa033a289858a4354cbb04c`:
https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/9600522de53973336fa033a289858a4354cbb04c/stb_dxt.h

Its MIT/public-domain dual license is included at the end of the header.
RHISoftwareS3TC uses it for runtime DXT1/DXT5 compression and the color blocks of DXT3.
